about: Modwerk source-only midi-retrig packages for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/modules/midi-retrig.

mods.title: MIDI Retrig
mods.summary: Use the native retrig menu on MIDI tracks A–H. Repeated notes follow the Digitakt sequencer, including chords, retrig rate, finite length and velocity changes.
mods.description: Use the native retrig menu on MIDI tracks A–H. Repeated notes follow the Digitakt sequencer, including chords, retrig rate, finite length and velocity changes.
mods.author: sumedho
mods.on_unit: The author reports this build fully tested and working with all six mods on a Digitakt 1, OS 1.53 and 1.54, for about one to two hours including project save/reload and a power cycle (2026-10-14).
